parameters.scope: Exact rational q,C are formal. Floating spectra use q=exp(-4lambda), C=Js^2/lambda. No finite-N limit is inferred from these checks.

numerical.scope: Floating double-resolution quadratures and independent 3x3 matrix exponential. Near-coincident energies are evaluated without singular divisions. These are not interval certificates.

scope: Spectral Volterra amplitudes, their charged cancellation and neutral divided-difference form. Does not establish the microscopic strong-return limit, higher-moment bounds or bulk mass identification.
